newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Telmex rises after upgrade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Telmex rises after upgrade.

text.p: Telefonos de Mexico rose Friday following a ratings upgrade to stand out among American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
Telefonos de Mexico, or Telmex, was up 1-2/16 to 52-15/16 in mid-morning trade. The company's ADRs were among the most-active issues on the New York Stock Exchange and topped ADR trade in New York.
Smith Barney analyst Peter Treadway raised his rating on Telmex to outperform from neutral and called the company's cellular and local service the "two jewels in the crown."
Among other active Latin American ADRs, Argentina's Banco de Galicia SA rose 2-1/8 to 32, above a 12-month closing high.
Volume was heavy and traders said the ADRs had been boosted in part by rumors that Banco de Galicia could be a takeover target.
Singapore software company Creative Technology Ltd fell 1-9/16 to 23-1/16 after rival Venture Manufacturing (Singapore) Ltd launched a new multimedia software.
Luxury goods company Gucci Group rose 1-10/16 to 64-7/16 after a story in BusinessWeek magazine outlined company plans for boosting its stock price.
In the story, chief executive Domenico de Sole expressed disappointment with the shares' fall over the last year.
Swedish telecommunications equipment company Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson fell 7/16 to 45-7/8.
Advancers led decliners 232 to 218 among 814 ADRs. The ADR group rose 0.07 percent and volume was 24.5 million ADRs.
ADRs allow U.S. trade of foreign shares.
